reply.description: Your next chat message to the user, in the user's language.

document.description: The document being drafted, after applying the conversation. Values are in English. Use an empty string for anything still unknown.

type.description: Id of the document the user confirmed they want, or empty while not chosen.

terms.description: Values of the chosen document's key terms. Include every term known so far.

title.description: Job title of the person signing.

noticeAddress.description: Email or postal address for notices.
